accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text is #4B5563 or darker on white backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (blue-500) are mandatory for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME SETUP: Ensure tailwind.config.js uses the specified font families (Work Sans for headings, Inter for body).

2. PUBLIC PROFILE (/username): This is the core feature. It must load instantly. Use a 'Container' pattern: <main className='max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-white md:border md:shadow-sm md:my-10 md:rounded-xl overflow-hidden'>. Inside, stack elements vertically: Avatar (centered, large), Name (H1), Title (H3 muted), Bio, Resume Button (Primary), WhatsApp Button (Secondary, Green-600), Portfolio Links (List items).
3. DASHBOARD: Use a clean Sidebar layout. Sidebar on desktop, Bottom Nav on mobile. Content area should be spacious (p-6). Use 'Card' components for sections like 'Edit Profile', 'Manage Links'.
4. FORMS: Split long forms into sections with headers. Don't use one giant form. Use clear labels.

5. LANDING PAGE: Keep it simple. Hero: 'Your Professional Bio in One Link'. CTA: 'Create Your Link'. Image: Use 'hero_professional' image on the right or as a subtle background. Features: 'Clean Design', 'Fast Loading', 'Resume Hosting'.
6. COMPONENT REUSE: Use Shadcn UI for standard elements (Buttons, Inputs, Dialogs, Dropdowns). Do not reinvent the wheel.
7. PERFORMANCE: Avoid large layout shifts. Optimize images.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds.
Do not use dark mode by default, strictly Light Mode as requested.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements.
Ensure mobile responsiveness is tested first.
